notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Zealous Lorecaster.
When Zealous Lorecaster and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Stretch from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Stretch during your draw step.
Repeat during your second extra turn
